description: Read-only XRPL NFT inventory lookup for one classic account using the native `account_nfts` method. The result provides NFT-specific fields such as `NFTokenID`, `Issuer`, `NFTokenTaxon`, `URI`, and `nft_serial`; use `marker` to continue pagination and `ledger_hash` or `ledger_index` to pin the inventory lookup to a specific ledger. Calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for NFTs owned by an account; use n9t2_xrpl_list_nft_offers for marketplace buy/sell offers on a specific NFTokenID, or n9t2_xrpl_list_account_objects when raw account ledger objects rather than NFT-specific fields are required.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose owned NFTs should be listed.
account.title: Account

ledger_hash.description: Optional ledger hash used to pin the NFT inventory lookup.
ledger_hash.title: Ledger Hash

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of owned NFT records to return.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_nfts
